topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I walked through the flickering light of the room, each shadow a story not told. The coffee, once an anchor of our mornings, now sits cold between us. They painted their days in the bold strokes of success, a job everyone envied. But the canvas had cracks, whispers of fabrication that now echo louder than the truths I once knew. I see the way they avoid my gaze, the hands that twitch as if trying to weave another tale. The silence, heavy and unyielding, carries the weight of what’s unsaid. Outside, the world continues, oblivious, while here, the air is thick with the remnants of a lie.
